summary: The team decided on a single‑curved, colorful rubber casing, standard batteries plus solar cells for power, a side scroll‑wheel with integrated buttons, a regular chip, and no LCD display. Corporate colours are grey and yellow. The Industrial Designer and User Interface Designer will collaborate to produce a prototype drawing on the SMARTboard within thirty minutes before the next meeting.
decisions: Use standard batteries combined with solar cells for power
Add a side scroll‑wheel integrated with buttons
